title: Shakespearean dating tips - Anthony John Peters
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】莎士比亞的約會技巧 - 安東尼約翰彼得斯（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Using the word Shakespeare within any classroom in the 21st century has become almost as dangerous for teachers
cues.en: Using the word Shakespeare within any classroom in the 21st century has become almost as dangerous for teachers
cues.zh: 使用莎士比亞這個字 在 21 世紀的課堂內 對老師而言其危險程度

cues.text: as putting balloons in a toaster.
cues.en: as putting balloons in a toaster.
cues.zh: 對老師而言其危險程度 就像把氣球放在烤麵包機裡一樣

cues.text: After uttering this simple word, the common teacher is met with a mass of groans,
cues.en: After uttering this simple word, the common teacher is met with a mass of groans,
cues.zh: 就像把氣球放在烤麵包機裡一樣 在說出這個簡單的字之後 老師會碰到一片哀嚎

cues.text: moans, devastated looks, and the occasional chair tossed in his or her direction.
cues.en: moans, devastated looks, and the occasional chair tossed in his or her direction.
cues.zh: 呻吟 及絕望的表情 偶爾還會被丟椅子 但莎士比亞的作品並不是無聊

cues.text: But Shakespearean works are not boring, confusing, long and painful plays written more than 400 years ago.
cues.en: But Shakespearean works are not boring, confusing, long and painful plays written more than 400 years ago.
cues.zh: 但莎士比亞的作品並不是無聊 難懂 在 400 多年前所寫下 又臭又長的劇本

cues.text: They're adventures relating to the extremities of human nature: love,
cues.en: They're adventures relating to the extremities of human nature: love,
cues.zh: 在 400 多年前所寫下 又臭又長的劇本 他們是冒險故事 訴說著人性的極端 愛

cues.text: hate, jealousy, zealous ambition, fear, mistrust, deception, and murder.
cues.en: hate, jealousy, zealous ambition, fear, mistrust, deception, and murder.
cues.zh: 愛 恨 嫉妒 勃勃野心 恐懼 懷疑 欺騙 及謀殺

cues.text: We owe much of our own language to his invention.
cues.en: We owe much of our own language to his invention.
cues.zh: 及謀殺 我們自己的語言 很多要歸功於他的創造

cues.text: He invented over 2,000 words for use in his plays, which still remain in the Oxford English Dictionary.
cues.en: He invented over 2,000 words for use in his plays, which still remain in the Oxford English Dictionary.
cues.zh: 他創造了超過二千個字 在他的戲劇中使用 而今仍然保留在牛津英語詞典裡 單字像「無數」

cues.text: Words like "countless" and "assassination" as well as phrases like
cues.en: Words like "countless" and "assassination" as well as phrases like
cues.zh: 而今仍然保留在牛津英語詞典裡 單字像「無數」 及「暗殺」 還有片語像

cues.text: "one fell swoop," "foul play," and even "to be in a pickle"
cues.en: "one fell swoop," "foul play," and even "to be in a pickle"
cues.zh: 還有片語像 「一舉」 「詐欺」 甚至是「陷入絕境」

cues.text: all originated from William's brilliant brain.
cues.en: all originated from William's brilliant brain.
cues.zh: 都是從威廉充滿才氣的腦袋而來 並且還有很多倣效

cues.text: And there are many echoes of Shakespeare's romantic language too.
cues.en: And there are many echoes of Shakespeare's romantic language too.
cues.zh: 都是從威廉充滿才氣的腦袋而來 並且還有很多倣效 莎士比亞的浪漫語言

cues.text: If you read <em>Romeo and Juliet</em>, you'll come across sentences like, "She doth teach the torches to burn bright,"
cues.en: If you read <em>Romeo and Juliet</em>, you'll come across sentences like, "She doth teach the torches to burn bright,"
cues.zh: 莎士比亞的浪漫語言 如果你讀羅密歐與茱麗葉 你會碰到詞句像是 「火炬遠不及她的明亮」

cues.text: and, "So shows a snowy dove trooping with crows."
cues.en: and, "So shows a snowy dove trooping with crows."
cues.zh: 及「像鴉群中一頭白鴿蹁躚」

cues.text: Both are quite clever metaphors, suggesting that Juliet is both exceptionally beautiful
cues.en: Both are quite clever metaphors, suggesting that Juliet is both exceptionally beautiful
cues.zh: 及「像鴉群中一頭白鴿蹁躚」 兩句都是相當高明的隱喻 暗示茱麗葉分外美麗

cues.text: and far moreso than anyone else.
cues.en: and far moreso than anyone else.
cues.zh: 姿貌絕倫 「妳在這黑夜裡如此地明亮

cues.text: "For thou art as glorious to this night, being o'er my head, as is a winged messenger of heaven,"
cues.en: "For thou art as glorious to this night, being o'er my head, as is a winged messenger of heaven,"
cues.zh: 「妳在這黑夜裡如此地明亮 在我上方（使我仰望） 如同天堂那有翼的使者」 是個比喻暗示者天使般的特質

cues.text: is a simile suggesting angelic qualities of the lady in question.
cues.en: is a simile suggesting angelic qualities of the lady in question.
cues.zh: 如同天堂那有翼的使者」 是個比喻暗示者天使般的特質 在這位好逑淑女身上

cues.text: This is not too different from today's comments like, "Hey, beautiful!"
cues.en: This is not too different from today's comments like, "Hey, beautiful!"
cues.zh: 這跟今天的品頭論足也差不多，像是 「嘿，美女！」 及「你是這裡最辣的！」

cues.text: and, "You're the hottest girl in the room." Shakespeare also uses
cues.en: and, "You're the hottest girl in the room." Shakespeare also uses
cues.zh: 及「你是這裡最辣的！」 莎士比亞也用了 稍微複雜一點的隱喻

cues.text: slightly more complex metaphors to describe the intentions of a mischievous man.
cues.en: slightly more complex metaphors to describe the intentions of a mischievous man.
cues.zh: 稍微複雜一點的隱喻 來描述公子哥兒的輕薄意圖 例如

cues.text: For instance, "This holy shrine, the gentle sin is this: My lips,
cues.en: For instance, "This holy shrine, the gentle sin is this: My lips,
cues.zh: 例如 「要是我這俗手上的塵汙

cues.text: two blushing pilgrims, ready stand to smooth that rough touch with a tender kiss,"
cues.en: two blushing pilgrims, ready stand to smooth that rough touch with a tender kiss,"
cues.zh: 「要是我這俗手上的塵汙 褻瀆了你的神聖的廟宇 這兩片嘴唇，含羞的信徒 願意用一吻乞求你宥恕」

cues.text: essentially means, "I wish to kiss you." Such male intentions were not limited
cues.en: essentially means, "I wish to kiss you." Such male intentions were not limited
cues.zh: 願意用一吻乞求你宥恕」 其實就是在說「我想要親你」 像這樣的男性意圖並不只限於

cues.text: to simple pecks on the cheek either.
cues.en: to simple pecks on the cheek either.
cues.zh: 在臉頰上的輕輕一啄而已

cues.text: An intentional ambiguity was often used as a cheeky means to proposition marriage
cues.en: An intentional ambiguity was often used as a cheeky means to proposition marriage
cues.zh: 含糊不清的暗示也常常被使用 因厚臉皮還意指求婚

cues.text: or a more intimate relationship.
cues.en: or a more intimate relationship.
cues.zh: 或更親密的關係

cues.text: Therefore, instead of viewing Shakespearean works as out-dated, boring, and unhelpful,
cues.en: Therefore, instead of viewing Shakespearean works as out-dated, boring, and unhelpful,
cues.zh: 或更親密的關係 所以與其視莎士比亞的作品 為過時、無聊、又無用

cues.text: start reading today and discover the best ways to get the one you love
cues.en: start reading today and discover the best ways to get the one you love
cues.zh: 為過時、無聊、又無用 不如今天就開卷閱讀 並在其中找到最好的方法 讓你所愛的人

cues.text: to love you back.
cues.en: to love you back.
cues.zh: 讓你所愛的人 也愛上你
